CLM-ARCH-0088.statement: H2-Ray decreases average PSNR by 0.034 dB relative to RaySplats in matched multi-view evaluation.

extra_quotes: We evaluate H 2-Ray on 8 scenes from Mip-NeRF 360 [2] and Deep Blending [6] (Figure 2), combining cycle-level modeling of the modified RT Core with measured RTX A5000 timings for all CUDA work.

The synthesizable C++/SystemC core is translated to RTL with Siemens Catapult HLS [18], then synthesized, placed, and routed at 28 nm, 0.9 V , and 1 GHz with Synopsys Fusion Compiler [20]; Figure 7 shows its layout.
GRTX has no public implementation at the time of writing, so we cannot directly compare against it.
